items.hook: One Night Only review – sex is legal for 12 hours a year in bizarre romcom
items.body:
‘What if The Purge was for premarital sex?’ is the odd, gimmicky elevator pitch for this slickly made yet ungainly oddity that can’t quite get past the grimness of its conceit

items.hook: Operation Burning Candle is a novel by Blyden Jackson published in 1973.
items.body: It describes a political conspiracy led by a group called the Black Warriors, whose leader is Vietnam War veteran and Harlem native Captain Aaron Rogers. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: The Pirate Loop is a BBC Books original novel written by Simon Guerrier and based on the long-running science fiction television series Doctor Who.
items.body: It features the Tenth Doctor and Martha Jones. The world is stranger than it lets on.

items.hook: Vikramarkudu is a 2006 Indian Telugu-language masala film co-written and directed by S.
items.body: Rajamouli, based on a story by V. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Korean War: Forty-two American prisoners of war were massacred by the Korean People's Army on a hill above Waegwan, South Korea.
items.body: The Korean War was an armed conflict fought on the Korean Peninsula between North Korea and South Korea and their allies. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: Islands Voyage: Robert Devereux, 2nd Earl of Essex, and Sir Walter Raleigh set sail on an expedition to the Azores.
items.body: The Islands Voyage, also known as the Essex-Raleigh Expedition, was an ambitious, but unsuccessful naval campaign sent by Queen Elizabeth I of England, and supported by the Dutch Republic, against the Spanish Empire and Portuguese Empire of Philip II from the House of Habsburg during the Anglo-Spanish War (1585–1604) and the Eighty Years' War. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: World War II: U.S. Marines raid the Japanese-held Pacific island of Makin.
items.body: World War II, or the Second World War, was a global conflict between two coalitions: the Allies and the Axis powers. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Tony review – knives out in tasty reheat of Anthony Bourdain’s memoir
items.body:
Dominic Sessa stars as a conceited yet vulnerable young chef alongside Antonio Banderas – but the feelgood factor is compromised by what we know of the author

For all the drugs and punch-ups, this is an unexpectedly sentimental com

items.hook: Barcelona attacks: A van is driven into pedestrians in La Rambla, killing 14 and injuring at least 100.
items.body: On the afternoon of 17 August 2017, 22-year-old Younes Abouyaaqoub drove a van into pedestrians on La Rambla street in Barcelona, Catalonia, Spain, killing 13 people and injuring at least 130 others, one of whom died 10 days later on 27 August. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: The Finnish War: The Battle of Alavus is fought.
items.body: The Finnish War was fought between the Kingdom of Sweden and the Russian Empire from 21 February 1808 to 17 September 1809 as part of the Napoleonic Wars. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes is a 2014 American science fiction action film directed by Matt Reeves and written by Mark Bomback and the writing team of Rick Jaffa and Amanda Silver.
items.body: The sequel to Rise of the Planet of the Apes (2011), it is the second installment in the Planet of the Apes reboot film series and the eighth film overall. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: The Home of Dark Butterflies is a 2008 Finnish film directed by Dome Karukoski and starring Niilo Syväoja, Tommi Korpela, Kristiina Halttu and Kati Outinen.
items.body: The film is an adaptation of the award-winning novel of the same name by Leena Lander. Worth a quiet trip down the rabbit hole.

items.hook: The novella Animal Farm by George Orwell is first published.
items.body: Animal Farm is a satirical allegorical dystopian novella, in the form of a beast fable, by George Orwell, first published in England on 17 August 1945. One of those things you can't un-know.

items.hook: I wish I had been a more rebellious teenager, says Bella Ramsey
items.body: Ramsey stars in a new film about a cancer survivor who attends “chemo camp” and finds friendship, love and freedom.
